segments.text: [excited] The octopus is basically an alien. Fact one: it has *three hearts*. Two pump blood through the gills, one pumps it to the body.
[curious] Fact two: its blood is *blue*. It runs on copper, not iron.
[surprised] And fact three: nine brains. One in the head, and a mini brain in every arm. [playfully] Tell me which fact got you!
